name: Tryphena
title: Faithful Worker in the Lord
summary: Tryphena was a Christian woman in the church at Rome whom Paul greets in his letter to the Romans. She is mentioned together with Tryphosa, and both are commended for their hard work in the Lord's service. Her name means 'delicate' or 'refined'.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul sends a personal greeting to Tryphena and Tryphosa in his letter to the Romans, acknowledging their faithful work for the Lord in the church.

keyEvents.title: Work in the Lord's Service
keyEvents.description: Tryphena is especially highlighted for working hard in the Lord, indicating her active and dedicated service in the early church.
